why: Drops the guard and reports `Mission 0` for a run whose stored level this build's campaign does not list -- reachable today through a developer session's `?dev=1&level=` jump. Split out of `route-host-paints-no-run-summary` at issue #555: with `total` removed from `CampaignRunSummary`, that entry's payload became identical to the real one for exactly this case, so the net had to move rather than be dropped. It is also the sharper statement of the contract -- the summary degrades to the lives half rather than inventing a position, and an invented one is worse than an omitted one because the Main Menu presents it with the same confidence as a true reading.
killedBy: createRouteHost: the Main Menu is painted from the stores by the page reports a mission it cannot place as null rather than inventing a position
